bltb4e188ef2f265c8f.title: Welcome to Multi Language POC
bltb4e188ef2f265c8f.description: This is a simple Content stack proof of concept using React
bltb4e188ef2f265c8f.content:
Check if localized fields can inherit or overwrite baseline English values smoothly, and evaluate how the CMS handles fallback languages if a translation doesn't exist yet.
